questions.stem: Most buff foods give a Well Fed buff of what length?
questions.explanation: Most buff foods give a 15-minute Well Fed buff plus 5% more experience from kills. The 5-minute and 1-hour figures are camp-kit and camp-feature cooldowns.

questions.stem: How many camp features does the Expert kit hold?
questions.explanation: The Basic kit holds 3 camp features, the Journeyman kit 5 and the Expert kit 10.

questions.stem: What cooldown do all camp features share?
questions.explanation: All camp features share a 1-hour cooldown. The 5-minute cooldown is on the kits.

questions.stem: Who drops the Journeyman Campfire blueprint?
questions.explanation: Lord Serpentis in Wailing Caverns drops the Journeyman Campfire blueprint. Cookie in the Deadmines drops the Cookie's Feast blueprint and Cookie's Stirring Rod.

questions.stem: Which Legacy perk makes food buffs last longer?
questions.explanation: Gourmand makes food buffs last longer. Master Chef gives extra cooking results, and Reagent Economy removes vendor reagents for tier-1 camp features.
Sage's Tea gives +44 healing. Nightfin Soup gives +22 spell damage, and Baked Salmon and Lobster Stew +28 spell damage.

questions.stem: What does Mightfish Steak give in Forever?
questions.explanation: Mightfish Steak gives +40 attack power. Grilled Squid and Hot Smoked Bass give +1% crit, and Smoked Desert Dumplings keep +20 Strength.

questions.stem: Foods that need an Iron Oven may stay scarce. What Cooking skill does the Iron Oven itself need?
questions.explanation: Icy Veins says the Iron Oven needs Cooking 300. Cooking 250 is the skill for Sage's Tea.
